action_summary: Made 'the Perfect Algorithm' real: one generic loop for any arbitrary environment that scans observed facts (affordance map), asks the right question (the action whose trial most shrinks what is unknown, closeness-probed when the env supports it), retrieves from memory what is known, fetches instant knowledge from the world on a completeness-gated basis, plans the shortest way over the learned model, executes and VERIFIES the goal is observed, generalizes from the one verified experience (the goal family + plan sketch + evidence hash -- never the raw trace as knowledge), admits the generalization on fresh instances it was not taught on, persists admitted priors (observed facts) and admitted rules (hypotheses) to an inspectable memory store, and replays admitted plan rules instantly on a repeat goal. Reuses environment_learning, jit_knowledge, the anti-unifier and the admission gate; adds no new runtime dependencies. Authority: NONE.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: The repo already contains the scan (environment_learning), the instant-knowledge fetch (jit_knowledge), the anti-unification (verified_skill_crystallizer), the admission gate (lesson_admission_gate) and the skill library. The missing mechanism is the loop that composes them: a scan-seeded, memory-indexed, goal-directed loop with an honest separator and honest persistence. Duplicating any of those pieces would add a second implementation of the same mechanism, which the laws forbid.
agent_orientation.independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox only: 18 new unit/integration tests, one generic-loop receipt (plan 6 actions on a 4x4 held-out grid, priors persisted), one code-repair admission receipt (ADMIT on unseen victims, fresh-defect replay PASS). No independent verifier ran any of this. Another identity must re-run before credit.

expected_parent_frontier_change: The same four reasoning streams can now be composed as one falsifiable algorithm with honest persistence, and a fresh instance of a family replays the model it was seeded with.

falsification_condition: FALSIFIED if: a rule from the store is replayed and the goal is not reached; a stored rule is served on a goal family it was not admitted for; a stored rule is served on an already-correct program that breaks it; the receipt numbers disagree with the receipt file; or any instant-knowledge fetch is counted as Brain capability.
honest_limits: authority NONE, producer-run sandbox, no independent verifier
the generic loop's plan-sketch rule was NOT admitted on fresh instances in this round and was therefore NOT persisted -- only priors (observed facts) were saved
one experience is a hypothesis, not a rule; the receipt says the rule is not identified
no GUI, browser, OSWorld or SWE-bench task was run in this round
no capability was registered and no truth was changed

truth.the_law_this_round_adds: One experience yields a hypothesis plus the one question that separates the survivors -- never a rule. Priors (observed transitions) are facts; rules (plan sketches / repair patterns) are hypotheses and are admitted only on fresh instances.
what_is_false_in_the_claim: that one verified experience is a sufficient rule
that exact actions should be saved as knowledge
that instant knowledge counts as capability
